With muscle full status, myofibrillar muscle protein synthesis is stimulated within 1 hour, but the stimulation returns to baseline within 3 hours despite sustained elevations in amino acid availability (34). Hence, it is hypothesized that consuming protein every few hours throughout the day optimizes muscle protein accretion by continually elevating levels of muscle protein synthesis and attenuating muscle protein breakdown (13, 128).
